findings.detail: IMB Midco Term Loan A stored/identifier spread is 6.00%, but the raw schedule shows 6M SOFR + 5.00%.
OID-OL Intermediate is paired with 7.17%, 9/2/2025, and 12/17/2027 from the following Planview row; the raw OID-OL row shows 9.84%, 6/11/2025, and 2/1/2029.

rationale: Class 2 within-row review. The blocker IMB identifier in the bundle carries Reference Rate and Spread 6M SOFR + 6.00%, while the raw schedule row for the same issuer, investment type, dates, interest rate, and PIK terms shows 6M SOFR + 5.00%. The secondary source-artifact row also reflects an extraction/row-alignment defect: OID-OL Intermediate is assigned 7.17% and Planview dates even though the raw OID-OL row shows 9.84%, 6/11/2025, and 2/1/2029, and the 7.17%/9/2/2025/12/17/2027 values belong to the adjacent Planview row.
